title: docs/intent+boundary contract + full prompt+plan+response curation sweep (Mac+Windows)
method: forge subagent + python scraper + manual curation
deliverables: docs/intent/<repo>.md for every canonical ecosystem repo (82 files)
docs/boundary/<repo>.md for every canonical ecosystem repo (123 files)
scripts/scrape.py (the scraper, all 7 sources, idempotent incremental)

mac.claude-code: ~/.claude/{history.jsonl, projects/*, plans/*, idea-seeds/*, evidence/*, civilization/*, file-history/*, todos/*, sessions/*}
mac.codex: ~/.codex/{history.jsonl, sessions/**/rollout-*.jsonl, session-archive/logs/*, prompts/*, rules/*, skills/*, memories/*, external_agent_session_imports.json, sqlite/codex-dev.db}
mac.cursor-agent: ~/.cursor/{prompt_history.json, projects/*/agent-transcripts/*, ai-tracking/ai-code-tracking.db, plans/*, commands/*, rules/*, skills/*}
mac.droid: n/a on Mac (covered by Codex on Windows)

drop_patterns: duplicate-continue: 'go on'/'continue'/'next' after first in same session
keep_with_link: truncated-paste: display empty but pastedContents non-empty (link to pasted content)

repo_bindings: auto via project-folder → repo-path mapping + ECOSYSTEM_MAP repo list; unbound → docs/curated-prompts/_orphan/. Special-case: bare `repos/` project path binds to `phenotype-registry` (the meta-repo).

push_status.pushed_via: fresh clone + git bundle (87KB) + git push (orphan root, no pack history)
push_status.rationale: The 2.0GB pack-objects bottleneck in the local registry repo blocked normal git push for >30 min. Worked around with orphan-branch bundle: 87KB bundle with no shared history was pushed in <60s.
push_status.future_push_strategy: To push the full 3.2GB curated corpus later: (1) cd /Users/kooshapari/CodeProjects/Phenotype/repos/phenotype-registry-intent-bundle, (2) git checkout chore/l7-001-curation-snapshot-orphan-2026-06-17 (create via same orphan trick), (3) git bundle create /tmp/curation.bundle HEAD, (4) from a fresh shallow clone: git push --force origin chore/l7-001-curation-snapshot-orphan-2026-06-17. The orphan trick works because there is no shared pack-objects history to walk.
